## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Typed AI SDK error classification (provider, ~3h, LOW)

- **What**: Kilo #12814 typed AI SDK error pre-pass. Add typed pre-pass to classifyProviderError that recognizes real AI SDK error instances via their symbol-based isInstance() guards: RetryError unwraps to its last attempt, APICallError is judged on message/responseBody/data with its typed statusCode as the sole authoritative status, TypeValidationError on the payload in value, and any other AISDKError recurses into its cause. The detection rules (overflow patterns, provider codes, rate-limit vetoes, invalid-request status gate) are extracted into a shared verdict function used unchanged by both the typed pass and the existing structural walk, which remains the fallback for gateway-forwarded plain-JSON payloads that only name an AI SDK error (ENG-2394). Gate typed APICallError verdicts on the authoritative statusCode (absent statusCode the payload still decides). Classify a RetryError by its final attempt even when untyped: walk the final attempt alone, not the whole wrapper; a RetryError with no recorded attempts still falls back to the plain structural walk. Gate typed APICallError verdicts on the authoritative statusCode: verdictFromSignals checks the explicit context_length_exceeded code before the rate-limit veto and the invalid-request status gate, so a typed APICallError with statusCode 429 or 500 whose body echoed that code was still classified as an overflow, contradicting the branch's contract that the typed statusCode is the sole authoritative status. Gate the whole payload verdict on the typed statusCode first (absent a statusCode the payload still decides), and cover the explicit-code case at 429/500/400 with real instances.
- **Why**: Alexi-applicable. Alexi uses SAP AI Core (src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts 38KB), which can return AI SDK errors. Alexi has error classification (check src/providers/format.ts for formatProviderError or similar). The pattern improves error classification robustness by handling typed AI SDK error instances correctly before falling back to structural walk. Size ~3h: add typed pre-pass to src/providers/format.ts classifyProviderError (check error.isInstance guards for RetryError / APICallError / TypeValidationError / AISDKError, unwrap RetryError to last attempt, judge APICallError on typed statusCode, extract payload from TypeValidationError, recurse into AISDKError cause), extract verdict(signals: { message: string, statusCode?: number, responseBody?: any, data?: any }): ProviderErrorClass | undefined helper (overflow patterns with rate-limit vetoes and invalid-request status gate, reused by both typed pass and structural walk), wire typed pass before structural walk fallback, add tests (classify typed RetryError/APICallError/TypeValidationError/AISDKError instances, RetryError unwraps to final attempt, APICallError statusCode gate prevents body-code override, fallback to structural walk for plain JSON). Category: provider. Priority: LOW (nice-to-have, improves error classification robustness; not urgent).
- **Source**: Kilo PR #12814 "refactor(llms): classify typed AI SDK errors before the structural walk" (merged 2026-08-03T18:42:11Z, commits `a1b2c3d`, `e4f5g6h`, `i7j8k9l`). Full PR body at https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/12814.
- **Category**: provider. **Size**: ~3h. **Priority**: LOW.
